lines.text: And burn him with their tapers.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: The truth being known,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: We’ll all present ourselves, dis-horn the spirit,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: And mock him home to Windsor.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: The children must

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Be practised well to this, or they’ll ne’er do ’t.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: I will teach the children their behaviours, and I will be like a

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: jackanapes also, to burn the knight with my taber.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: That will be excellent. I’ll go buy them vizards.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: My Nan shall be the queen of all the fairies,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Finely attired in a robe of white.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: That silk will I go buy.
[_Aside_.]

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: And in that time

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Shall Master Slender steal my Nan away,

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: And marry her at Eton.—Go, send to Falstaff straight.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Nay, I’ll to him again in name of Brook.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: He’ll tell me all his purpose. Sure, he’ll come.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Fear not you that. Go, get us properties

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: And tricking for our fairies.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Let us about it. It is admirable pleasures and fery honest knaveries.
[_Exeunt Page, Ford and Evans._]

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Go, Mistress Ford.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Send quickly to Sir John to know his mind.
[_Exit Mistress Ford._]

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: I’ll to the Doctor. He hath my good will,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: And none but he, to marry with Nan Page.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: That Slender, though well landed, is an idiot,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: And he my husband best of all affects.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: The Doctor is well moneyed, and his friends

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Potent at court. He, none but he, shall have her,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Though twenty thousand worthier come to crave her.
[_Exit._]

scenes.setting: A room in the Garter Inn

lines.text: Enter Host and Simple.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: What wouldst thou have, boor? What, thick-skin? Speak, breathe,

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: discuss; brief, short, quick, snap.

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: Marry, sir, I come to speak with Sir John Falstaff from Master Slender.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: There’s his chamber, his house, his castle, his standing-bed and

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: truckle-bed. ’Tis painted about with the story of the Prodigal, fresh

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: and new. Go, knock and call. He’ll speak like an Anthropophaginian unto

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: thee. Knock, I say.

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: There’s an old woman, a fat woman, gone up into his chamber. I’ll be so

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: bold as stay, sir, till she come down. I come to speak with her,

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: indeed.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Ha? A fat woman? The knight may be robbed. I’ll call.—Bully knight!

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Bully Sir John! Speak from thy lungs military. Art thou there? It is

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: thine host, thine Ephesian, calls.
[_Above_.]

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: How now, mine host?

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Here’s a Bohemian-Tartar tarries the coming down of thy fat woman. Let

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: her descend, bully, let her descend. My chambers are honourable. Fie!

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Privacy? Fie!
Enter Falstaff.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: There was, mine host, an old fat woman even now with me, but she’s

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: gone.

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: Pray you, sir, was’t not the wise woman of Brentford?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Ay, marry was it, mussel-shell. What would you with her?

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: My master, sir, my Master Slender, sent to her, seeing her go through

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: the streets, to know, sir, whether one Nym, sir, that beguiled him of a

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: chain, had the chain or no.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: I spake with the old woman about it.

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: And what says she, I pray, sir?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Marry, she says that the very same man that beguiled Master Slender of

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: his chain cozened him of it.

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: I would I could have spoken with the woman herself. I had other things

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: to have spoken with her too, from him.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: What are they? Let us know.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Ay, come. Quick.

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: I may not conceal them, sir.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Conceal them, or thou diest.

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: Why, sir, they were nothing but about Mistress Anne Page, to know if it

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: were my master’s fortune to have her or no.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: ’Tis, ’tis his fortune.

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: What sir?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: To have her, or no. Go, say the woman told me so.

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: May I be bold to say so, sir?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Ay, sir; like who more bold?

lines.speaker: SIMPLE
lines.text: I thank your worship; I shall make my master glad with these tidings.
[_Exit Simple._]

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Thou art clerkly, thou art clerkly, Sir John. Was there a wise woman

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: with thee?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Ay, that there was, mine host; one that hath taught me more wit than

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: ever I learned before in my life; and I paid nothing for it neither,

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: but was paid for my learning.
Enter Bardolph.

lines.speaker: BARDOLPH
lines.text: Out, alas, sir, cozenage, mere cozenage!

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Where be my horses? Speak well of them, varletto.

lines.speaker: BARDOLPH
lines.text: Run away, with the cozeners. For so soon as I came beyond Eton, they

lines.speaker: BARDOLPH
lines.text: threw me off from behind one of them, in a slough of mire, and set

lines.speaker: BARDOLPH
lines.text: spurs and away, like three German devils, three Doctor Faustuses.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: They are gone but to meet the Duke, villain, do not say they be fled.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Germans are honest men.
Enter Sir Hugh Evans.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Where is mine host?

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: What is the matter, sir?

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Have a care of your entertainments. There is a friend of mine come to

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: town tells me there is three cozen-Germans that has cozened all the

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: hosts of Readings, of Maidenhead, of Colebrook, of horses and money. I

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: tell you for good will, look you. You are wise, and full of gibes and

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: vlouting-stocks, and ’tis not convenient you should be cozened. Fare

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: you well.
[_Exit Evans._]
Enter Doctor Caius.

lines.speaker: CAIUS
lines.text: Vere is mine host de Jarteer?

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Here, Master Doctor, in perplexity and doubtful dilemma.

lines.speaker: CAIUS
lines.text: I cannot tell vat is dat, but it is tell-a me dat you make grand

lines.speaker: CAIUS
lines.text: preparation for a Duke de Jamany. By my trot, dere is no duke that the

lines.speaker: CAIUS
lines.text: court is know to come. I tell you for good will. Adieu.
[_Exit Doctor Caius._]

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Hue and cry, villain, go!—Assist me, knight, I am undone.—Fly, run, hue

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: and cry, villain, I am undone!
[_Exeunt Host and Bardolph._]

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: I would all the world might be cozened, for I have been cozened and

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: beaten too. If it should come to the ear of the court how I have been

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: transformed, and how my transformation hath been washed and cudgelled,

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: they would melt me out of my fat drop by drop, and liquor fishermen’s

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: boots with me. I warrant they would whip me with their fine wits till I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: were as crestfallen as a dried pear. I never prospered since I forswore

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: myself at primero. Well, if my wind were but long enough, I would

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: repent.
Enter Mistress Quickly.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Now, whence come you?

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: From the two parties, forsooth.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: The devil take one party and his dam the other, and so they shall be

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: both bestowed. I have suffered more for their sakes, more than the

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: villainous inconstancy of man’s disposition is able to bear.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: And have not they suffered? Yes, I warrant, speciously one of them.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Mistress Ford, good heart, is beaten black and blue, that you cannot

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: see a white spot about her.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: What tellst thou me of black and blue? I was beaten myself into all the

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: colours of the rainbow, and was like to be apprehended for the witch of

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Brentford. But that my admirable dexterity of wit, my counterfeiting

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: the action of an old woman, delivered me, the knave constable had set

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: me i’ the stocks, i’ the common stocks, for a witch.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Sir, let me speak with you in your chamber, you shall hear how things

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: go, and, I warrant, to your content. Here is a letter will say

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: somewhat. Good hearts, what ado here is to bring you together! Sure,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: one of you does not serve heaven well, that you are so crossed.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Come up into my chamber.
[_Exeunt._]

scenes.setting: Another room in the Garter Inn

lines.text: Enter Fenton and Host.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Master Fenton, talk not to me. My mind is heavy. I will give over all.

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Yet hear me speak. Assist me in my purpose,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: And, as I am a gentleman, I’ll give thee

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: A hundred pound in gold more than your loss.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: I will hear you, Master Fenton, and I will, at the least, keep your

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: counsel.

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: From time to time I have acquainted you

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: With the dear love I bear to fair Anne Page,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Who mutually hath answered my affection,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: So far forth as herself might be her chooser,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Even to my wish. I have a letter from her

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Of such contents as you will wonder at,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: The mirth whereof so larded with my matter

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: That neither singly can be manifested

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Without the show of both, wherein fat Falstaff

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Hath a great scene; the image of the jest

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: I’ll show you here at large. Hark, good mine host:

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Tonight at Herne’s oak, just ’twixt twelve and one,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Must my sweet Nan present the Fairy Queen—

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: The purpose why is here—in which disguise,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: While other jests are something rank on foot,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Her father hath commanded her to slip

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Away with Slender, and with him at Eton

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Immediately to marry. She hath consented. Now, sir,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Her mother, even strong against that match

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: And firm for Doctor Caius, hath appointed

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: That he shall likewise shuffle her away,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: While other sports are tasking of their minds,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: And at the dean’ry, where a priest attends,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Straight marry her. To this her mother’s plot

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: She, seemingly obedient, likewise hath

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Made promise to the doctor. Now thus it rests:

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Her father means she shall be all in white

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: And in that habit, when Slender sees his time

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: To take her by the hand and bid her go,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: She shall go with him. Her mother hath intended

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: The better to denote her to the doctor,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: For they must all be masked and vizarded—

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: That quaint in green she shall be loose enrobed,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: With ribbons pendant flaring ’bout her head;

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: And when the doctor spies his vantage ripe,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: To pinch her by the hand, and on that token

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: The maid hath given consent to go with him.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Which means she to deceive, father or mother?

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Both, my good host, to go along with me.

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: And here it rests, that you’ll procure the vicar

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: To stay for me at church, ’twixt twelve and one,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: And, in the lawful name of marrying,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: To give our hearts united ceremony.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Well, husband your device; I’ll to the vicar.

lines.speaker: HOST
lines.text: Bring you the maid, you shall not lack a priest.

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: So shall I evermore be bound to thee;

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Besides, I’ll make a present recompense.
[_Exeunt._]

scenes.setting: A room in the Garter Inn

lines.text: Enter Falstaff and Mistress Quickly.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Prithee, no more prattling. Go. I’ll hold. This is the third time; I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: hope good luck lies in odd numbers. Away, go! They say there is

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: divinity in odd numbers, either in nativity, chance, or death. Away!

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: I’ll provide you a chain, and I’ll do what I can to get you a pair of

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: horns.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Away, I say; time wears. Hold up your head, and mince.
[_Exit Mistress Quickly._]
Enter Ford.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: How now, Master Brook! Master Brook, the matter will be known tonight

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: or never. Be you in the park about midnight, at Herne’s oak, and you

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: shall see wonders.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Went you not to her yesterday, sir, as you told me you had appointed?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: I went to her, Master Brook, as you see, like a poor old man, but I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: came from her, Master Brook, like a poor old woman. That same knave

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Ford, her husband, hath the finest mad devil of jealousy in him, Master

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Brook, that ever governed frenzy. I will tell you he beat me

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: grievously, in the shape of a woman; for in the shape of man, Master

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Brook, I fear not Goliath with a weaver’s beam, because I know also

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: life is a shuttle. I am in haste. Go along with me; I’ll tell you all,

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Master Brook. Since I plucked geese, played truant, and whipped top, I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: knew not what ’twas to be beaten till lately. Follow me, I’ll tell you

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: strange things of this knave Ford, on whom tonight I will be revenged,

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: and I will deliver his wife into your hand. Follow. Strange things in

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: hand, Master Brook! Follow.
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Page, Shallow and Slender.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Come, come. We’ll couch i’ the castle ditch till we see the light of

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: our fairies. Remember, son Slender, my daughter—

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: Ay, forsooth. I have spoke with her, and we have a nay-word how to know

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: one another. I come to her in white and cry “mum”; she cries “budget”;

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: and by that we know one another.

lines.speaker: SHALLOW
lines.text: That’s good too. But what needs either your “mum” or her “budget”? The

lines.speaker: SHALLOW
lines.text: white will decipher her well enough. It hath struck ten o’clock.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: The night is dark. Light and spirits will become it well. Heaven

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: prosper our sport! No man means evil but the devil, and we shall know

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: him by his horns. Let’s away; follow me.
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Mistress Page, Mistress Ford and Doctor Caius.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Master Doctor, my daughter is in green. When you see your time, take

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: her by the hand, away with her to the deanery, and dispatch it quickly.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Go before into the park. We two must go together.

lines.speaker: CAIUS
lines.text: I know vat I have to do. Adieu.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Fare you well, sir.
[_Exit Caius._]

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: My husband will not rejoice so much at the abuse of Falstaff as he will

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: chafe at the doctor’s marrying my daughter. But ’tis no matter. Better

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: a little chiding than a great deal of heartbreak.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS FORD
lines.text: Where is Nan now, and her troop of fairies, and the Welsh devil Hugh?

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: They are all couched in a pit hard by Herne’s oak, with obscured

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: lights, which, at the very instant of Falstaff’s and our meeting, they

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: will at once display to the night.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS FORD
lines.text: That cannot choose but amaze him.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: If he be not amazed, he will be mocked; if he be amazed, he will every

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: way be mocked.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS FORD
lines.text: We’ll betray him finely.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Against such lewdsters and their lechery,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Those that betray them do no treachery.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS FORD
lines.text: The hour draws on. To the oak, to the oak!
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Sir Hugh Evans disguised, and children as Fairies.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Trib, trib, fairies. Come, and remember your parts. Be pold, I pray

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: you, follow me into the pit, and when I give the watch-’ords, do as I

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: pid you. Come, come; trib, trib.
[_Exeunt._]
Enter Falstaff wearing a buck’s head.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: The Windsor bell hath struck twelve, the minute draws on. Now the

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: hot-blooded gods assist me! Remember, Jove, thou wast a bull for thy

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Europa; love set on thy horns. O powerful love, that in some respects,

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: makes a beast a man, in some other a man a beast! You were also,

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Jupiter, a swan for the love of Leda. O omnipotent love, how near the

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: god drew to the complexion of a goose! A fault done first in the form

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: of a beast; O Jove, a beastly fault! And then another fault in the

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: semblance of a fowl; think on’t, Jove, a foul fault! When gods have hot

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: backs, what shall poor men do? For me, I am here a Windsor stag, and

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: the fattest, I think, i’ the forest. Send me a cool rut-time, Jove, or

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: who can blame me to piss my tallow? Who comes here? My doe?
Enter Mistress Ford and Mistress Page.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS FORD
lines.text: Sir John? Art thou there, my deer, my male deer?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: My doe with the black scut! Let the sky rain potatoes, let it thunder

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: to the tune of “Greensleeves”, hail kissing-comfits and snow eringoes;

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: let there come a tempest of provocation, I will shelter me here.
[_He embraces her._]

lines.speaker: MISTRESS FORD
lines.text: Mistress Page is come with me, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Divide me like a bribed buck, each a haunch. I will keep my sides to

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: myself, my shoulders for the fellow of this walk, and my horns I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: bequeath your husbands. Am I a woodman, ha? Speak I like Herne the

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: hunter? Why, now is Cupid a child of conscience; he makes restitution.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: As I am a true spirit, welcome!
[_A noise of horns within._]

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Alas, what noise?

lines.speaker: MISTRESS FORD
lines.text: Heaven forgive our sins!

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: What should this be?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: MISTRESS FORD and MISTRESS PAGE.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Away, away!
[_They run off._]

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: I think the devil will not have me damned, lest the oil that’s in me

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: should set hell on fire; he would never else cross me thus.
Enter Mistress Quickly as the Queen of Fairies, Sir Hugh Evans as a Satyr, Pistol as Hobgoblin, Anne Page and children as Fairies, carrying tapers.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Fairies, black, grey, green, and white,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: You moonshine revellers and shades of night,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: You orphan heirs of fixed destiny,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Attend your office and your quality.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Crier Hobgoblin, make the fairy oyes.

lines.speaker: PISTOL
lines.text: Elves, list your names; silence, you airy toys!

lines.speaker: PISTOL
lines.text: Cricket, to Windsor chimneys shalt thou leap,

lines.speaker: PISTOL
lines.text: Where fires thou find’st unraked and hearths unswept,

lines.speaker: PISTOL
lines.text: There pinch the maids as blue as bilberry.

lines.speaker: PISTOL
lines.text: Our radiant queen hates sluts and sluttery.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: They are fairies, he that speaks to them shall die.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: I’ll wink and couch. No man their works must eye.
[_Lies down upon his face._]

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Where’s Bead? Go you, and where you find a maid

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: That ere she sleep has thrice her prayers said,

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Rein up the organs of her fantasy;

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Sleep she as sound as careless infancy.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: But those as sleep and think not on their sins,

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Pinch them, arms, legs, backs, shoulders, sides, and shins.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: About, about!

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Search Windsor castle, elves, within and out.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Strew good luck, oafs, on every sacred room,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: That it may stand till the perpetual doom

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: In state as wholesome as in state ’tis fit,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Worthy the owner and the owner it.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: The several chairs of order look you scour

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: With juice of balm and every precious flower.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Each fair instalment, coat, and several crest,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: With loyal blazon, evermore be blest!

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: And nightly, meadow-fairies, look you sing,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Like to the Garter’s compass, in a ring.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Th’ expressure that it bears, green let it be,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: More fertile-fresh than all the field to see;

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: And _Honi soit qui mal y pense_ write

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: In em’rald tufts, flowers purple, blue and white,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Like sapphire, pearl, and rich embroidery,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Buckled below fair knighthood’s bending knee.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Fairies use flowers for their charactery.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Away, disperse! But till ’tis one o’clock,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Our dance of custom round about the oak

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Of Herne the hunter let us not forget.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Pray you, lock hand in hand, yourselves in order set;

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: And twenty glow-worms shall our lanterns be,

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: To guide our measure round about the tree.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: But stay, I smell a man of middle earth.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Heavens defend me from that Welsh fairy, lest he transform me to a

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: piece of cheese!

lines.speaker: PISTOL
lines.text: Vile worm, thou wast o’erlooked even in thy birth.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: With trial-fire touch me his finger-end.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: If he be chaste, the flame will back descend

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: And turn him to no pain; but if he start,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: It is the flesh of a corrupted heart.

lines.speaker: PISTOL
lines.text: A trial, come.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Come, will this wood take fire?
[_They put the tapers to his fingers, and he starts._]

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: O, o, o!

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: Corrupt, corrupt, and tainted in desire!

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: About him, fairies, sing a scornful rhyme,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS QUICKLY
lines.text: And, as you trip, still pinch him to your time.

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: Fie on sinful fantasy!

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: Fie on lust and luxury!

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: Lust is but a bloody fire,

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: Kindled with unchaste desire,

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: Fed in heart, whose flames aspire,

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: As thoughts do blow them, higher and higher.

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: Pinch him, fairies, mutually;

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: Pinch him for his villainy.

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: Pinch him and burn him and turn him about,

lines.speaker: SONG
lines.text: Till candles and starlight and moonshine be out.

[_During the song they pinch him, and Doctor Caius comes one way and steals away a boy in green; and Slender another way takes a boy in white; Fenton comes in and steals away Anne Page. A noise of hunting is heard within and all the fairies run away. Falstaff pulls off his buck’s head, and rises up._]
Enter Page, Ford, Mistress Page and Mistress Ford.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Nay, do not fly. I think we have watched you now.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Will none but Herne the hunter serve your turn?

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: I pray you, come, hold up the jest no higher.—

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Now, good Sir John, how like you Windsor wives?

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: See you these, husband?
[_She points to the horns._]

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Do not these fair yokes

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Become the forest better than the town?

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Now, sir, who’s a cuckold now? Master Brook, Falstaff’s a knave, a

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: cuckoldly knave. Here are his horns, Master Brook. And, Master Brook,

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: he hath enjoyed nothing of Ford’s but his buck-basket, his cudgel, and

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: twenty pounds of money, which must be paid to Master Brook. His horses

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: are arrested for it, Master Brook.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS FORD
lines.text: Sir John, we have had ill luck, we could never meet. I will never take

lines.speaker: MISTRESS FORD
lines.text: you for my love again, but I will always count you my deer.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: I do begin to perceive that I am made an ass.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Ay, and an ox too. Both the proofs are extant.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: And these are not fairies? I was three or four times in the thought

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: they were not fairies; and yet the guiltiness of my mind, the sudden

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: surprise of my powers, drove the grossness of the foppery into a

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: received belief, in despite of the teeth of all rhyme and reason, that

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: they were fairies. See now how wit may be made a Jack-a-Lent when ’tis

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: upon ill employment!

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Sir John Falstaff, serve Got, and leave your desires, and fairies will

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: not pinse you.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Well said, fairy Hugh.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: And leave you your jealousies too, I pray you.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: I will never mistrust my wife again, till thou art able to woo her in

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: good English.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Have I laid my brain in the sun, and dried it, that it wants matter to

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: prevent so gross o’erreaching as this? Am I ridden with a Welsh goat

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: too? Shall I have a cox-comb of frieze? ’Tis time I were choked with a

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: piece of toasted cheese.

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: Seese is not good to give putter. Your belly is all putter.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: “Seese” and “putter”? Have I lived to stand at the taunt of one that

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: makes fritters of English? This is enough to be the decay of lust and

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: late-walking through the realm.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Why, Sir John, do you think, though we would have thrust virtue out of

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: our hearts by the head and shoulders, and have given ourselves without

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: scruple to hell, that ever the devil could have made you our delight?

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: What, a hodge-pudding? A bag of flax?

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: A puffed man?

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Old, cold, withered, and of intolerable entrails?

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: And one that is as slanderous as Satan?

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: And as poor as Job?

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: And as wicked as his wife?

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: And given to fornications, and to taverns, and sack, and wine, and

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: metheglins, and to drinkings and swearings and starings, pribbles and

lines.speaker: EVANS
lines.text: prabbles?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Well, I am your theme. You have the start of me. I am dejected, I am

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: not able to answer the Welsh flannel. Ignorance itself is a plummet

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: o’er me. Use me as you will.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Marry, sir, we’ll bring you to Windsor to one Master Brook, that you

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: have cozened of money, to whom you should have been a pander. Over and

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: above that you have suffered, I think to repay that money will be a

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: biting affliction.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Yet be cheerful, knight. Thou shalt eat a posset tonight at my house,

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: where I will desire thee to laugh at my wife, that now laughs at thee.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Tell her Master Slender hath married her daughter.
[_Aside_.]

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Doctors doubt that. If Anne Page be my daughter, she is, by

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: this, Doctor Caius’ wife.
Enter Slender.

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: Whoa, ho, ho, father Page!

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Son, how now! How now, son, have you dispatched?

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: Dispatched? I’ll make the best in Gloucestershire know on’t. Would I

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: were hanged, la, else!

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Of what, son?

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: I came yonder at Eton to marry Mistress Anne Page, and she’s a great

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: lubberly boy. If it had not been i’ the church, I would have swinged

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: him, or he should have swinged me. If I did not think it had been Anne

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: Page, would I might never stir! And ’tis a postmaster’s boy.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Upon my life, then, you took the wrong.

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: What need you tell me that? I think so, when I took a boy for a girl.

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: If I had been married to him, for all he was in woman’s apparel, I

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: would not have had him.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Why, this is your own folly. Did not I tell you how you should know my

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: daughter by her garments?

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: I went to her in white and cried “mum”, and she cried “budget”, as Anne

lines.speaker: SLENDER
lines.text: and I had appointed, and yet it was not Anne, but a postmaster’s boy.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Good George, be not angry. I knew of your purpose, turned my daughter

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: into green, and indeed she is now with the doctor at the deanery, and

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: there married.
Enter Doctor Caius.

lines.speaker: CAIUS
lines.text: Vere is Mistress Page? By gar, I am cozened, I ha’ married _un garçon_,

lines.speaker: CAIUS
lines.text: a boy; _un paysan_, by gar, a boy. It is not Anne Page. By gar, I am

lines.speaker: CAIUS
lines.text: cozened.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Why, did you take her in green?

lines.speaker: CAIUS
lines.text: Ay, by gar, and ’tis a boy. By gar, I’ll raise all Windsor.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: This is strange. Who hath got the right Anne?
Enter Fenton and Anne Page.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: My heart misgives me. Here comes Master Fenton.—How now, Master Fenton!

lines.speaker: ANNE
lines.text: Pardon, good father. Good my mother, pardon.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Now, mistress, how chance you went not with Master Slender?

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Why went you not with Master Doctor, maid?

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: You do amaze her. Hear the truth of it.

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: You would have married her most shamefully,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Where there was no proportion held in love.

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: The truth is, she and I, long since contracted,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Are now so sure that nothing can dissolve us.

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Th’ offence is holy that she hath committed,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: And this deceit loses the name of craft,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Of disobedience, or unduteous title,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Since therein she doth evitate and shun

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: A thousand irreligious cursed hours,

lines.speaker: FENTON
lines.text: Which forced marriage would have brought upon her.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Stand not amazed, here is no remedy.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: In love, the heavens themselves do guide the state.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Money buys lands, and wives are sold by fate.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: I am glad, though you have ta’en a special stand to strike at me, that

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: your arrow hath glanced.

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: Well, what remedy? Fenton, heaven give thee joy!

lines.speaker: PAGE
lines.text: What cannot be eschewed must be embraced.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: When night-dogs run, all sorts of deer are chased.

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Well, I will muse no further.—Master Fenton,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Heaven give you many, many merry days!

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Good husband, let us every one go home,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: And laugh this sport o’er by a country fire,

lines.speaker: MISTRESS PAGE
lines.text: Sir John and all.

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: Let it be so, Sir John,

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: To Master Brook you yet shall hold your word,

lines.speaker: FORD
lines.text: For he tonight shall lie with Mistress Ford.
[_Exeunt._]
